caption: The drawing depicts a metal object composed of a vertical rod with a rounded finial at the top and three protruding, slightly curved prongs arranged at different heights along the central rod. The prongs are supported by a triangular frame connected at their base. This assembly stands on a shallow, rectangular tray with upturned edges and handles on both short sides. The piece as a whole rests on three arched legs attached to a rounded central hub, which stands above and partly inside the tray. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance, with delicate shading used to suggest dimensionality and texture. The background is plain and unadorned, and the drawing is centered, providing a clear view of the object’s structure and details.
title: Roasting Stand with Drip Pan
